description: Search uploaded documents (receipts, invoices). Can also list documents by status without a query — status ["pending", "error"] is the Incoming queue. Called with no arguments it lists the newest uploads (up to 25).

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

query.description: Search query (optional when filtering by status or type)

status.description: Filter by status: pending, error, processed, matched

name: search_documents
title: Search Documents
